## 🏆 Signature Projects & Impact (STAR Formula)

### 1. SIM Notaris & PPAT — Enterprise Vault v6.31.0 (notaris)
- **Context:** Unified corporate operational system for Notary & PPAT offices handling service registration, physical archive tracking, multi-role statutory approval, and state tax escrow compliance.
- **Action:** Engineered 2-tier architecture using Laravel 13 Sanctum and Svelte 5 (Runes) with 6 canonical RBAC roles, automated register numbering (`NOT-YYYY-XXXX` / `PPAT-YYYY-XXXX`), Snapshot Deep-Copy service master templates, Kanban & 0–100% progress tracking, physical archive locator (Map, Box, Rack, Row), 15MB document upload/preview viewer (`salinan_minuta`, `persyaratan`, `berkas_tambahan`), dual-pocket ledger separating office honorarium from state tax/PNBP escrow (BPHTB, PPh Final, PNBP BPN/AHU/Fidusia with NTPN/Bapenda validation), A4 receipt/invoice printing, and CWE-1236-immune UTF-8 BOM CSV export.
- **Impact:** 100% green test suite (121 automated tests, 1,148 assertions); 0 error / 0 a11y warning static build; ~65ms average latency (P99 < 150ms); zero discrepancy in tax escrow auditing; immune to Error 1040 on 25-connection MySQL limit (`L <= 0.16`, `SESSION_DRIVER=file`).
- **Stack:** Laravel 13 Sanctum, Svelte 5 (Runes), Tailwind CSS v4, MySQL / SQLite WAL, 6-Role RBAC, Snapshot Deep-Copy, Dual-Pocket Escrow, NTPN Validation, PHPUnit.
- **Repository:** [https://github.com/misbahudin98/notaris](https://github.com/misbahudin98/notaris)

### 2. SIM-PQTM: Modul LTQ Tahfidz & Tahsin / Agenda Hafalan (yayasan-pqtm)
- **Context:** Dedicated Quranic memorization & recitation tracking module (Lembaga Tahsin & Tahfidz Qur'an / LTQ) for Yayasan Pendidikan Qur'an Thaifah Manshurah (PQTM), managing daily halaqah agendas, tahsin/tahfidz journals, tasmi' examinations, and guardian monitoring.
- **Action:** Engineered module using Laravel 13 Sanctum, Svelte 5 (Runes), and MySQL/SQLite WAL covering Halaqah & Rumah Tahfidz management (anti-conflict student assignment per academic year + Ustadzah Badal substitute teacher tracking), 4-session daily memorization & tahsin journal logging (`Ziyadah`, `Muraja'ah`, `Talaqqi`) with atomic bulk input, 1–30 Juz Tasmi' graduation exams with dynamic scoring weights and Mudir/Admin Syahadah approval locking, real-time Guardian Portal (`/wali/tahfidz`), and strict halaqah-scoped authorization (BOLA defense).
- **Impact:** Verified by 6 dedicated LTQ PHPUnit test suites (part of 160 passed tests / 1,606 assertions in the repo); 0 error / 0 a11y warning Svelte 5 static build; real-time parent transparency; immune to Error 1040 on 25-connection shared hosting (`L <= 0.16`).
- **Stack:** Laravel 13 Sanctum, Svelte 5 (Runes), Tailwind CSS v4, MySQL / SQLite WAL, Halaqah & Badal Workflow, Tasmi' Dynamic Scoring, Portal Wali Santri, PHPUnit.
- **Repository:** Private Client System (Internal Production Architecture)

### 3. Twinnie Group: Ekosistem Web Layanan Kesehatan Integratif (twinnie-group)
- **Context:** High-performance web platform for integrative family healthcare in Malang Raya (Baby Spa, Traditional Chinese Medicine/Acupuncture, Psychology, and Sharia Partnership).
- **Action:** Developed purely static, high-performance web architecture without heavy runtime server compilers, achieving sub-second load times (<1.0s), full WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, and reactive WhatsApp booking deep-linking.
- **Impact:** Sub-second First Contentful Paint (<1.0s) on mobile 4G networks; 100% zero silent failure booking flow; scalable static hosting with zero server licensing overhead.
- **Stack:** Semantic HTML5, Modular Vanilla JS, Tailwind CSS, WCAG 2.1 AA, JSON-LD Schema.
- **Live Platform:** [twinniegroup.com](https://twinniegroup.com) | **Repository:** [github.com/misbahudin98/twinnie-group](https://github.com/misbahudin98/twinnie-group)

### 4. Sistem Informasi PPDB Terpusat & Multi-Campus Notification Gateway
- **Context:** Centralized new student admission platform spanning 5 educational tiers (Baby School, TK, SD, SMP, SMA) at Ar-Rohmah Putri.
- **Action:** Built secure RESTful API backend powered by Laravel Passport (OAuth 2.0) and MySQL; designed automated WhatsApp & Email notification gateways for multi-stage verification and payment confirmation.
- **Impact:** Scaled to manage >10,000 registered applicant & student accounts; 70% reduction in document verification latency; 99.8% notification gateway uptime.
- **Stack:** Laravel Passport, OAuth 2.0, MySQL Schema, WhatsApp Gateway, SMTP Email.

### 5. Buku Induk Santri & Pipeline Migrasi 12.117 Record (Zero Data Loss)
- **Context:** Database modernization eliminating years of fragmented and conflicting student/staff records from legacy SQL and Excel dumps.
- **Action:** Formulated automated ETL extraction, deduplication, and anomaly cleansing pipeline into a normalized 3NF MySQL schema based on NIS Yayasan (NISY).
- **Impact:** 12,117 records (9,312 historical students, 800 applicants, 2,005 staff) migrated with 100% integrity (zero data loss); resolved all historical accounting and public relations record discrepancies.
- **Stack:** ETL Scripting, Data Cleansing, MySQL 3NF, NISY Architecture.

### 6. Aplikasi Kepegawaian & Digital Workflow Automation (SIM-SDM)
- **Context:** Institutional HR lifecycle management digitizing paper-based bureaucracy for 2,005 active employees.
- **Action:** Developed centralized web interface with digital forms and multi-level approval workflows for leave, study permits, status changes, contract renewals, and terminations.
- **Impact:** 85% paperless HR operations; leave approval turnaround reduced to <24 hours.
- **Stack:** PHP, jQuery, MySQL, Tailwind CSS, Digital Approval Engine.

## 🤖 AI Agent Architecture & Skill Governance (`.agents/`)
This workspace incorporates an international-standard agentic pair-programming system based on **Anthropic Research** (*Building Effective Agents*, Dec 2024), **Google DeepMind Progressive Disclosure**, and **McKinsey MECE Partitioning**.

### 1. Active Skills Registry
- [`portfolio-architect`](.agents/skills/portfolio-architect/SKILL.md):
  - **Trigger Tags:** `@portfolio`, `@portfolio-architect`, `#portfolio`
  - **Domain Scope:** Developer portfolio audits, ATS Schema validation, 60fps GSAP motion recipes, ISO 24495-1 plain-language STAR case-study templates, and Web3/Motion defensive UI/UX.
  - **Key Invariants:** [`.agents/rules/portfolio_invariants.md`](.agents/rules/portfolio_invariants.md)
  - **CLI Helper:** `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ".agents/skills/portfolio-architect/scripts/audit-portfolio.ps1"`

- [`prompt-architect`](.agents/skills/prompt-architect/SKILL.md):
  - **Trigger Tags:** `@prompt`, `@pa`, `@prompt-architect`, `#prompt`
  - **Domain Scope:** Enterprise prompt engineering, Anthropic XML-delimited prompt synthesis, prompt smell audits (anti-slop), and agent customization governance.
  - **Key Invariants:** [`.agents/rules/skill_governance.md`](.agents/rules/skill_governance.md)
  - **CLI Helper:** `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ".agents/skills/prompt-architect/scripts/audit-skills.ps1"`

- [`job-application-tracker`](.agents/skills/job-application-tracker/SKILL.md):
  - **Trigger Tags:** `@lamaran`, `@apply`
  - **Domain Scope:** End-to-end job application intake & tracking in `tracker/applications.json`, extraction of salary/benefits/target email/target WhatsApp, humanist per-platform message drafting (Email, WhatsApp official & info-desk, Glints, LinkedIn, Other), tailored CV + conditional Surat Lamaran (with `assets/ttd_cropped.png`) + single-PDF bundling ending with `assets/cv/berkas - tanpa sensitif.pdf`.
  - **Key Invariants:** [`.agents/rules/lamaran_trigger.md`](.agents/rules/lamaran_trigger.md)
  - **CLI Helper:** `python ".agents/skills/job-application-tracker/scripts/merge-application-pdf.py"`

### 2. End-to-End Job Application & Skill Usage Workflow
When processing a new job vacancy or refining career materials, agents combine skills cleanly without domain collision:
1. **Profile & Portfolio Alignment (`@portfolio`):** Keep [`docs/cv_memory_ssot.md`](docs/cv_memory_ssot.md) and [`index.html`](index.html) accurate, ATS-friendly, and free of AI cliché wording using plain-language writing standards.
2. **Instruction & Tone Quality (`@prompt`):** Enforce anti-slop humanist phrasing, structured output contracts, and MECE skill compliance.
3. **Vacancy Intake -> JSON -> Bundled PDF -> 1-Click Send (`@lamaran`):**
   - **Intake & Extract:** Parse company, role, salary, `benefits` (facilities), `target_email`, `target_whatsapp`, required documents, and filename rules.
   - **Per-Platform Messages & JSON Log:** Generate distinct humanist messages per channel (Email subject+body, WhatsApp including non-official info contacts, Glints, LinkedIn, Other) and store under a sequential ID (`APP-001`, `APP-002`, ...) in [`tracker/applications.json`](tracker/applications.json).
   - **PDF Bundling:** Build a role-matched CV (plus Surat Lamaran stamped with `assets/ttd_cropped.png` and/or Portfolio only when requested), then append [`assets/cv/berkas - tanpa sensitif.pdf`](./assets/cv/berkas%20-%20tanpa%20sensitif.pdf) strictly at the end via `merge-application-pdf.py`.
   - **Interactive Web Dashboard:** Manage records (Add/Edit/Delete/Status/Export/Import JSON) via [`tracker/index.html`](tracker/index.html) backed by [`tracker/api.php`](tracker/api.php), and trigger 1-click sends via **Kirim WA**, **Outlook Web**, **App Outlook (Mailto)**, or **Gmail Web**.

### 3. Initial Setup & Private Local Prerequisites
Before using this repository as a personal portfolio and automated job-application workspace (or after cloning to a new machine), configure these 6 items (`assets/ttd.png`, `assets/ttd_cropped.png`, generated `Lamaran_*.pdf`/`Surat_Lamaran_*.pdf`, and `tracker/applications.json` are excluded from Git via `.gitignore`):
1. **CV Master Memory (`docs/cv_memory_ssot.md`):** Populate career history, production projects, education, and technical skills (without sensitive NIK/SK/DOB data) as the source of truth for tailored CVs and messages.
2. **Portfolio Web & Assets (`index.html`, `assets/`, Canonical Link):** Update personal details, projects, screenshots, and contact channels in `index.html`, and align the official portfolio URL in `.agents/rules/lamaran_trigger.md` and `docs/cv_memory_ssot.md`.
3. **Signature Images (`assets/ttd.png` & `assets/ttd_cropped.png`):** Place transparent PNG signature files locally (gitignored); inserted automatically only when a job vacancy requests a formal Surat Lamaran.
4. **Combined Attachments & Base CV (`assets/cv/berkas - tanpa sensitif.pdf`, `assets/cv/CV_Misbahudin_Portofolio_Umum.pdf`, `cv.pdf`):** Store non-sensitive diplomas/transcripts/certificates in `berkas - tanpa sensitif.pdf` so `merge-application-pdf.py` always appends it at the end.
5. **Local Tracker Database (`tracker/applications.json`):** Gitignored so salaries, benefits, HR emails, and WhatsApp contacts stay private; initialize on a new device with `{"applications": []}` or add the first entry via `tracker/index.html` / `@lamaran`.
6. **Local Runtime Tools:** PHP 8+ (e.g., Laragon) so `tracker/index.html` persists edits directly via `tracker/api.php` (offline `localStorage` + Export/Import JSON also works), plus Python 3 with `pypdf` for `merge-application-pdf.py`.

## 🔄 Data Architecture & ETL Codex: Data Engineering vs Data Analysis
- **Mental Model:** *"Data Engineer builds the pipeline and water treatment infrastructure; Data Analyst formulates the nutrition and serves the drink for business consumption."*
- **Data Engineering Perspective (Pipeline, Scale, & Reliability):**
  - **Extract:** Memory-safe chunk streaming (`Chunking 500 rows`, continuous RAM consumption $\le 32\text{MB}$), Change Data Capture (CDC), zero-lock ingestion.
  - **Transform:** Third Normal Form (3NF) relational normalization, formula injection mitigation (CWE-1236), strict schema casting.
  - **Load:** Transactional atomic inserts wrapped in `DB::transaction()` with automatic rollback, Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), and SHA-256 dual-checksum reconciliation (12,117 / 12,117 records verified with 100% match and zero data loss).
- **Data Analysis Perspective (Business Semantics, Metrics, & Delivery):**
  - **Extract / Discovery:** Single Source of Truth (SSoT) audit, eliminating semantic discrepancies between operational departments (e.g. Humas vs Finance).
  - **Transform / Modeling:** Dimensional Star Schema (`dim_santri`, `dim_waktu`, `fact_pembayaran`), formal metric calculations (MoM, YoY, cohort retention), and business logic data cleansing.
  - **Load / BI Delivery:** Aggregated data mart generation for sub-2-second executive dashboards, high data-to-ink ratio visualization, and actionable strategic insights.
- **Full Architecture Specification:** Documented in [`docs/etl_data_engineering_vs_data_analysis.md`](docs/etl_data_engineering_vs_data_analysis.md).

## 📂 Key File Manifest
- [`index.html`](index.html): Main 6-chapter Warm Swiss Editorial portfolio markup, JSON-LD Schema, interactive 4-stage Excel ETL Pipeline showcase, and GSAP motion engine.
- [`design.md`](design.md): Single Source of Truth (SSoT) for visual tokens, typography, 6-chapter architecture, and GSAP compositor choreography.
- [`docs/cv_memory_ssot.md`](docs/cv_memory_ssot.md): Sanitized, Git-versioned CV Master Memory SSoT (career history, Notaris & Excel ETL details, education, and CV formatting rules; excludes NIK/SK/DOB).
- [`tracker/index.html`](tracker/index.html): Interactive Job Application Tracker web dashboard (KPI metrics, search/filter, manual CRUD, platform message modal, Export/Import JSON, and 1-click WA/Outlook Web/App Outlook/Gmail send buttons).
- [`tracker/api.php`](tracker/api.php): Local PHP REST endpoint syncing CRUD updates cleanly into `tracker/applications.json`.
- [`tracker/applications.json`](tracker/applications.json): Structured JSON repository storing sequential application records (`APP-001`, etc.), benefits, contacts (`target_email`, `target_whatsapp`), and per-platform humanist messages.
- [`assets/ttd_cropped.png`](assets/ttd_cropped.png): Cropped transparent signature asset automatically inserted when a job posting requires a formal Surat Lamaran.
- [`assets/cv/CV_Misbahudin_Portofolio_Umum.pdf`](./assets/cv/CV_Misbahudin_Portofolio_Umum.pdf): Verified primary human ATS curriculum vitae available for direct download.
- [`assets/cv/berkas - tanpa sensitif.pdf`](./assets/cv/berkas%20-%20tanpa%20sensitif.pdf): Supporting attachment packet appended strictly at the end of merged job-application PDFs.
- [`cv.pdf`](cv.pdf): Root-level ATS curriculum vitae copy.
- [`README.md`](README.md): Comprehensive human documentation, layman-friendly job application workflow guide, and system runbook.
- [`llms.txt`](llms.txt): This AI-accelerated index and executive summary file.
- [`assets/`](assets/): Production screenshot & video artifacts (`irwan-baddu.png`, `irwan-baddu1.png`, `yayasan-pqtm.jpg`, `yayasan-pesantren.jpg`, `ppdb.jpg`, `santri.png`, `sdm1.png`, `smk-taruna-bhakti.jpeg`, `smk-taruna-bhakti.mp4`, `taruna-bhakti-2.jpeg`, `arrohmah.jpeg`, `arrohmah1.jpeg`, `arrohmah2.jpeg`, `twinnie-group.jpg`).
- [`netlify.toml`](netlify.toml): Security headers, cache policies, and Netlify deployment configuration.
- [`docs/etl_data_engineering_vs_data_analysis.md`](docs/etl_data_engineering_vs_data_analysis.md): Master architectural whitepaper on ETL dual-perspective: Data Engineering vs Data Analysis.
- [`.agents/rules/portfolio_invariants.md`](.agents/rules/portfolio_invariants.md): Hard invariants for web portfolio (ATS, GSAP, Parallax, Plain Language ISO 24495-1, WCAG 2.2 AA).
- [`.agents/rules/lamaran_trigger.md`](.agents/rules/lamaran_trigger.md): Reactive rules for `@lamaran`/`@apply` intake, signature placement, PDF merging, and tracker persistence.
- [`.agents/rules/skill_governance.md`](.agents/rules/skill_governance.md): Absolute constitution governing skill boundaries and zero collision.
- [`.agents/skills/job-application-tracker/SKILL.md`](.agents/skills/job-application-tracker/SKILL.md): Runbook for end-to-end job application drafting, PDF merging, and JSON tracking.
